LESSON: PHOTOGRAPHY

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Creating and Performing
Topic 2.6: Photography

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Photography. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Which are the ethical issues to consider in photography?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify different viewpoints in photography

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify different viewpoints in photography
   In simple words: practise until you can identify different viewpoints in photography. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Photography using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Photography in the examples.
2. Explain Photography to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Photography.
4. Show that you can: identify different viewpoints in photography

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Photography using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Photography important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Take photographs inspired by the environment to showcase beautiful scenes in our country (Kenya) focusing on; varied scene and viewpoints,
2. Citizenship: learner visit their surroundings to take photographs to showcase beautiful scenes in our country (Kenya).

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify different viewpoints in photography

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
